area: blaze-cli store: putting expansion records beside a CrateScope record (store/plain_place.rs, engine_store.rs put_all)
annoyance: The brief named `Tag(u16::MAX - 3)` for EXPANSION_TAG, which is CODE_TAG already (ROOT MAX, IMAGE MAX-1, DRIVE MAX-2, CODE MAX-3, POINTER MAX-4, START_LIST MAX-5). blaze-cas `Lent::put_parts` refuses equal bytes under another namespace or tag, so a content-keyed record shared by many owners cannot be put blindly a second time.
workaround: EXPANSION_TAG is MAX-6. `put_record` probes with `get` first and answers `Same` for equal bytes held under any namespace or tag; only new bytes are put.
